thinking about it more, it means that we need the `indexName` on here too, that way we can craft a key: `''.concat(indexName, '-', attribute)`. More ideally this key would be calculated here already to avoid doing duplicate and maybe wrong work in Vue
facets is an object, not an array
(this method expects an algoliasearch response, not a SearchResults)
same remark here and in the other instances, we need to make sure we don't ignore these errors, since they actually behave wrong (skip helper steps, which won't happen IRL)

body:
Can you be more explicit by "duplicate"?

If you mean UI duplicate, this is what we already do in React InstantSearch and what we plan to do in the first iteration for InstantSearch.js too. We don't plan to prefix the label by the index name because it's not useful from the user POV.

Note that it is rather unlikely that you've got the same attribute in nested indices.
I mean totally  identical. We can't avoid showing them twice in the UI, but we can avoid React errors if we have enough information to make them unique for the key
Right, that makes sense! I'll add the `indexName` key to the CurrentRefinements items.
